policy.scope: Material factual, evidence, provenance, methodology or data-contract errors in published project content.
principles: Correct the canonical page or data object when an error is verified.
Preserve source provenance and review dates when evidence-sensitive text changes.
Record material corrections here instead of silently presenting the historical statement as if it never existed.
Minor copy edits, formatting fixes and non-substantive wording changes do not require ledger entries.
